notes.subject: מחרב מפיהם
notes.rationale: 'The sword of their mouth' — destructive speech as a weapon; rendered as a relative clause to keep the picture.

notes.subject: ⟨mɔgɔ fitiniw⟩ / ⟨olu⟩
notes.rationale: Hebrew delays אביון to the verse end; Bambara needs the object stated early, so it is supplied in brackets and repeated.

notes.subject: חזק
notes.rationale: Adjective used substantively, 'the strong (one)' — 'bonyabagatigi' makes the noun explicit.

translation: A bɛ ⟨mɔgɔ fitiniw⟩ bɔ npan-w la minnu bɛ u ka da kɔnɔ, ani a bɛ ⟨olu⟩ bɔ bonyabagatigi bolo ma.

tokens.gloss: minnu bɛ u ka da kɔnɔ
